title: CreditApplicant
description: One person applying for vehicle credit, with their own consent. Monetary amounts are whole units of the application's currency. national_id, date_of_birth and drivers_license are sensitive: transmit them only inside this request, never in URLs, logs, error details or responses. national_id is optional here; a deployment declares in its capabilities whether it requires, accepts or refuses it.

suffix.description: Name suffix, such as Jr. or III.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth as an RFC 3339 full-date (YYYY-MM-DD). Sensitive.

national_id.description: Optional government identifier used for the credit inquiry. Sensitive.

type.description: ssn: US Social Security Number. itin: US Individual Taxpayer Identification Number. sin: Canadian Social Insurance Number.

value.description: Nine digits without spaces or dashes.

state.description: Issuing US state or Canadian province code.

expires_on.description: Expiry date as an RFC 3339 full-date.

marital_status.description: Optional. Provide only where the creditor may lawfully ask, such as joint applications or community-property states.

relationship.description: Co-applicant only: relationship to the primary applicant.

email.description: Applicant email address. At least one of email or phone MUST be present.

phone.description: Applicant phone number in E.164 format. At least one of email or phone MUST be present.

address.description: Current residential address. Street line, city, state or province, and postal code are required.

housing_status.description: own: owned outright. mortgage: owned with a mortgage. rent: rented. family: living with family. other: anything else.

monthly_housing_payment.description: Monthly rent or mortgage payment in whole currency units; 0 when none.

months_at_address.description: Whole months at the current address.

previous_address.description: Previous residential address. Lenders typically need it when months_at_address is under 24.

months_at_previous_address.description: Whole months at the previous address.

employer_name.description: Current employer or business name. Required when employment_status is employed, self_employed or military.

employer_phone.description: Employer phone number in E.164 format.

months_at_employer.description: Whole months with the current employer.

gross_monthly_income.description: Gross monthly income from employment or the primary source, before tax, in whole currency units.

other_monthly_income.description: Optional additional monthly income in whole currency units. Alimony, child support or separate maintenance need not be revealed unless the applicant wants it considered.

other_income_source.description: Source of other_monthly_income. Required with it.

previous_employer_name.description: Previous employer. Lenders typically need it when months_at_employer is under 24.

months_at_previous_employer.description: Whole months with the previous employer.

consent.description: This applicant's own credit authorization. Required.
